items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Pooch and his buddies, Joe Harris of course. I don't know how much I got out of it.

ctx.x: It can't be, play it again.

So I listened to it. That was it. Well when he got through he came to me, he says, or he went to Boots, he says, Boots, who's number is that? I was looking around. He says, L.D., he says, I did. I said, well I don't know. Somebody's got a claiming number. I said, I don't know. I just, well okay, it's my number. I said, what's your name? He says, these guy's writing. My name was Lawrence Douglas Harris. I said, well what if I said L.D.? My name was L.D., I said, I don't know what's your name. I said, well that's…
It wasn't too much in those days. You know it, what? I know what I got out of mine.
